Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Oliver
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 04/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 601 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the various local 911 districts by an undetermined amount to (1) implement alternative response methods to emergency calls and (2) require 911 operators to remain on each call until the caller is connected with the emergency service provider.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
